title: FALSE takes zero arguments, rejects any argument at entry, and returns the logical value FALSE
statement: In Excel 16.0 builds 20430 and 20527, FALSE() takes no arguments, refuses any supplied argument at formula entry, and evaluates to the logical FALSE (distinct from text "FALSE"; compares above numbers and text and below TRUE, and coerces to 0 when passed as a direct numeric argument while ignored in held ranges by numeric aggregates). Matches 2/2 full-bank and 1/1 pinned FALSE rows.
basis: Measured across Excel 16.0 build 20430 (1/1 pinned row in witnesses/FALSE.json) and Excel 16.0.20527 (admit2-answers-false-{scalar,special}.json; 2/2 full-bank rows).

repros.recorded_in: Excel 16.0 build 20430, Windows 64-bit; CPU not recorded
Excel 16.0 build 20527, Windows, Compatibility Version 2, cell_value2_bulk; bitness and CPU not recorded
